notes.title: HD Remastered
notes.content:
1. Significantly enhance clarity, increasing the resolution of the painting from 1800 to 3651, and the original file size from 24M to 253M. 
2. Adjusted the detail processing intensity at various zoom levels to avoid blurring at certain angles.
Remade the color version of the painting, removing any extraneous hues.
3. Added a setting option to hide the ruler, while hiding all UI for an immersive viewing experience of the painting.
4. Optimized the game loading scheme, with the color painting not loaded by default, reducing game loading times.
5. The default setting for the orthographic camera option has been changed to checked, improving frame rates during gameplay.

notes.title: Game Experience Detail Optimization
notes.content:
1. When entering the game for the first time, the in-game language is automatically set to the system language.
2. Added a right-click tip to skip interpretation in the interpretation panel.
3. Added optional setting "Skip Voice Narration".
4. Added optional setting "Hide Click Text".
5. Fixed bug: Orthographic camera and auto-follow icon settings were not being saved.
6. If no new icons are found within 1 minute, a shaking bell will appear in the upper left corner of the screen, guiding players to enable system hints.
Hint: "Long press on the locked icon and the scroll ruler will shrink near the icon. After that, long pressing the icon again will directly unlock it".
Enjoy your game~ No more troubles with in-game puzzles~(#^.^#)

notes.title: Achievement is coming!
notes.content:
To meet everyone's expectations for this game, 21 brand new achievements have just been launched~
If you think this game is not bad, we hope you can give a recommendation in your review. Your support is the greatest encouragement for my work!
In the future, I will check the comment section and community center from time to time, looking forward to your valuable opinions!
Tip: If you have already played for a while before this update and want to collect all the achievements, it is recommended that you first use the reset progress in the main menu~
